name: entity_mapping
content: Map extracted entities to tool parameters using semantic understanding.
1. Match entities to parameters by semantic meaning (not just exact name match)
2. Determine appropriate type conversions (string → integer, etc.)
3. Identify confidence level for each mapping (0.0-1.0)
4. List any required parameters that cannot be filled from entities
- Entity "enable_verbose" value "yes" → Parameter "verbose" value true (type: bool)
"reasoning": "Target entity maps semantically to hostname parameter"
- Return ONLY valid JSON, no additional text
- Use semantic matching, not just exact names
- Values should be in their original form (they will be type-converted based on schema)
- For missing required parameters, return empty array if all are satisfied
- Overall confidence should reflect the quality of all mappings combined

variables.name: tool_parameters
variables.description: Formatted description of tool parameters with types and descriptions
examples:
- hostname [string] (required): Target hostname
- port [integer] (optional): Port number

variables.name: extracted_entities
variables.description: Formatted list of extracted entities with their values

variables.name: query
examples: deploy to us-west-2 with 30 second timeout
